title: Whether a coordinate is queried
statement: Let $T$ be a finite alphabet decision tree on $n$ coordinates with alphabet $Ω$, let $i$ be one of its coordinates, and let $x$ assign an alphabet symbol to every coordinate. The tree queries $i$ on input $x$ exactly when $i$ appears in the query trace of $T$ on $x$.
